claim: At their meetings on Sunday 29 November 2026, OPEC+ ministers keep oil production targets for January–March 2027 unchanged from the levels in force for December 2026.

runs.scenario: A release explicitly extends all seven listed targets unchanged into January but says nothing about other participants. One reader could count the unchanged extension as YES because no other change was announced; another could resolve NO because the criterion requires the release to state that no other participant's level changes.
runs.yes_requires: An OPEC+ production decision announced on 29 November 2026 Vienna time must keep the seven listed countries at their specified December 2026 levels for January 2027 and for any February or March 2027 targets it sets.
